title: net.protocol_negotiated
description: M8B § Acceptance 'Semver negotiation accepts a minor-newer server' + 'Semver negotiation rejects a major-mismatched client'. Emitted on every cf-net handshake by both sides; payload carries the session_semver agreed upon plus the granted feature subset. NOT cosmetic (sim-relevant + non-droppable under M4 cosmetic backpressure).

session_semver_packed.description: The lower of (server, client) when both agree on major+minor. Zero when accepted=false.

download_url.description: Server-supplied URL for the client to download an update. Present on reject only.
